All 24 printed photo numbers (D2619-4 through D2700-2 and K5657-3; photographers Peggy Greb, Stephen Ausmus, Seth Britch, Brad Fritz, Regis Lefebure, Neil Sanscrainte and Dong Wang) were resolved on 2026-09-17 in the ARS Image Gallery (https://www.ars.usda.gov/oc/images/photos/nov12/<id>/), with photographers matching the printed credits. The masthead also states no endorsement by USDA is implied. Uncredited elements are the flag treatments on pages 1, 2 and 14 (the cover photo is D2700-2), small holly ornaments on the index pages 22-23, and the USDA, ARS and 150 Years marks and mailing panel on page 24.
